description: Create a DRAFT in the user's connected Outlook mailbox. Nothing is sent: the draft waits in Outlook's Drafts folder, and chat shows it as a card with Open in Outlook. For a new email pass to, subject and body; to reply, pass reply_to_message_id and body (reply_all=true to answer everyone). Write a plain-text body in the user's voice: short paragraphs separated by a blank line, '- ' for a list, no markdown emphasis or headings. Use this whenever the user wants an email written to someone from their Outlook mailbox.

account.description: Email address of the Outlook mailbox to draft in. Omit to use the first connected mailbox.

reply_to_message_id.description: The id of the message to reply to, for a reply draft.

subject.description: Subject line, for a new email.

to.description: Recipient addresses, for a new email.

name: create_outlook_draft
title: Draft Outlook email
